reason: When I need solar for the shop I will ask my cousin and the neighbour who did his pharmacy, and use the same installer. An app I never heard of is not where I start, and I am not ready to buy this month anyway.
objection: The dollar moves every week, so written offers from companies I don't know mean nothing by the time I have the cash. And who is behind this app? Nobody in the market has told me about it.
would_change_my_mind: A relative or a shop owner near me telling me they used it and the price they got held, or the check found a fake battery in their installer's quote.
